name: agent-pingu
description: Vault-backed engineering loop for any development work: talk, research, ADR, plan, diagnose, execute, verify, retro. State lives in a project-local Obsidian vault; tasks mirror to GitHub Issues.

vault_dir.title: Vault directory
vault_dir.description: Path to the vault, relative to the repo root.

gh_repo.title: GitHub repo
gh_repo.description: owner/repo for Issue mirroring. Leave empty to use the current git remote.

autonomy.title: Autonomy level
autonomy.description: full-loop runs the whole lane then stops once for review. gated stops after every phase.
